BL-1504 — Swarm stamp-off: hotfix 6e05b02dd3 made wake dedup seat-aware (a respawned or rotated seat with an unchanged mailbox is woken once, fresh-target) and made the chase sweep consume the per-sweep resident wake budget only when a wake landed - review the landed diff, confirm or refute, open narrow follow-ups; never rewrite it and never write the ledger decision
What it solves: ## What
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What needs sign-off is the DISPOSITION only: that reviewing the landed diff of 6e05b02dd3 (BL-811 / BL-849 posture) rather than re-implementing it is right, and that medium is the right sever…
BL-1504 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1504" (or "reject BL-1504 <reason>") to act.
